project_type: Flask web app (Python) with single HTML page + separate CSS/JS modules
build_system: Flask (no build step), deployed via Railway with Dockerfile/nixpacks
verification_instructions: 1. Run python -c 'import app' to verify no import errors. 2. Check CSS/JS syntax validity. 3. Verify HTML structure is valid.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No test suite exists. Validation is AST/import-based.
contribution_requirements: Do not modify TikTok downloader logic or endpoints. Focus only on MAKIMA AI chat area.
key_patterns: Single-page app with view switching via JS (ui.js navigateTo function). CSS is split into modules (variables, base, layout, components, animations, drawer, responsive, makima-ai). The makima-ai.css handles all AI chat page styling. makima-ai.js handles all chat logic including localStorage-based multi-chat, speech synthesis, and API calls. View switching adds 'makima-ai-body' class to body and hides the main header when AI view is active.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), templates/index.html (single template), static/css/ (8 CSS modules), static/js/ (8 JS modules), static/img/ (avatar + owner images)
